title: 先出运后到票，原票随后红冲

actors.config.reviewer: 配置与交易档案发布人（独立复核）
actors.cost.checker: 核价复核（核实、评估、冻结）

chain: BRC-001: the S3 chain and D1 §5 steps 1–17 to export lot lot.1 (shipment.1 documented, its documents released)
observed: 先出运: 120 PCS delivered (verified), shipped, exported (lot.1 released by customs); the payable 600.00 of the verified delivery confirmed and paid before any invoice
后到票: invoice pin-01a1d2ff-5427-737e-8755-fb12f93a98d9 verified and matched 120; lot.1's case allocates it (4 lines) and records the expected 78.00

红冲: red invoice pin-01a1d2ff-54a5-76ba-a225-32ecbbbcf014 verified: pin-01a1d2ff-5427-737e-8755-fb12f93a98d9 reversed (reversed_by pin-01a1d2ff-54a5-76ba-a225-32ecbbbcf014), its 4 matches → review, the case's 4 allocations → review; planning the case → INVALID_STATE

交付事实保留: PUR deliveries [map[order_line_id:L1 purchase_quantity:24 remaining_quantity:0 sku_id:ST01.red.S spec_revision:1 unit_id:PCS unit_revision:1 verified_quantity:24] map[order_line_id:L2 purchase_quantity:36 remaining_quantity:0 sku_id:ST01.red.M spec_revision:1 unit_id:PCS unit_revision:1 verified_quantity:36] map[order_line_id:L3 purchase_quantity:12 remaining_quantity:0 sku_id:ST01.blue.S spec_revision:1 unit_id:PCS unit_revision:1 verified_quantity:12] map[order_line_id:L4 purchase_quantity:48 remaining_quantity:0 sku_id:ST01.blue.M spec_revision:1 unit_id:PCS unit_revision:1 verified_quantity:48]], FUL shipped 120, lot.1 960.00 unchanged; the payable 600.00 (paid) unchanged; PurchaseInvoiceVerified of the red invoice names reversed pin-01a1d2ff-5427-737e-8755-fb12f93a98d9 and review_commitment_ids [commitment.1] (no consumer: B2b's payable rests on the delivery)

退税资料分别处理: corrected invoice pin-01a1d2ff-57ab-716a-8e52-65bbe2741d7a verified and matched 120; 4 allocations replace the reviewed ones (replaced 4, standing 4); the case is planned; the reversed invoice and its review stay on record
not_executed: China customs (single window): submissions and receipts are recorded manually by the documentation clerk (CN-M01); the receipts' original texts are synthetic
the tax authority: invoices are synthetic scans imported and verified by tax.officer; refund declarations, approvals and payments are recorded from synthetic evidence
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the carrier's, forwarder's and inspection agency's systems: bookings, B/Ls and reports are entered from EVD evidence
a real identity provider (the test's local OIDC issuer mints every token)
the user interface (中文操作 is outside the API repository)
